subject: Draft: Eval trajectory + MAP sketch — initial share
body:
From: Hannah Schmitt <hannah_schmitt@redwood.com>
To: Jenna Porter <jenna@acmehealth.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>, Jonas Weber <jonas_weber@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 10 May 2027 16:12:00 -0700
Subject: Draft: Eval trajectory + MAP sketch — initial share

Hi Jenna,

Thanks again for the call this morning. Per our discussion, I've sketched a lightweight mutual action plan (MAP) tailored to the 60-day evaluation you mentioned. The goal of this doc is to:

- Align stakeholders and decision gates
- Define success metrics and acceptance criteria
- Provide a realistic cadence for technical validation + procurement

What I'm sending in this message:
1) Link to a MAP starter doc (editable): https://docs.google.com/document/d/1aBcD_example_map_link ("REDWOOD_MAP_starter_kit_v1.gdoc")
2) Attached stakeholder RACI (stakeholder_raci.xlsx) that we can iterate during the kickoff
3) A short acceptance checklist (conceptual) inside the doc — we'll attach a formal spreadsheet after we lock owners

High-level proposal (60-day trajectory):
- Week 0: Kickoff + architecture workshop (identify data paths, network/VPC needs)
- Week 1–2: Pilot integration (sample requests, token sizing, perf baseline)
- Week 3–4: Quality evaluation and prompt/eval tuning; acceptance criteria drafted
- Week 5: Procurement & legal review (term sheet shared)
- Week 6–8: Final acceptance, SLA signoff, and plan to prod (or next steps)

Initial success metrics (examples):
- 95th-percentile latency <= 150ms for 512-token runs
- Cost per 1k inference tokens within agreed target
- Quality: BLEU-like match on labeled eval set >= 0.78 (or customer-accepted equivalent)

Please take a look at the starter doc and the RACI. If that looks good, can we lock a 90-minute workshop on either Tuesday May 18 or Wednesday May 19 to run the architecture + test data plan?

Thanks — I know timelines are tight; we built the doc to be intentionally minimal so it's easy to adapt.

Best,
Hannah Schmitt
Enterprise AE | Redwood Inference
hannah_schmitt@redwood.com

---
From: Jenna Porter <jenna@acmehealth.com>
To: Hannah Schmitt <hannah_schmitt@redwood.com>
Cc: Tom Alvarez <tom.alvarez@acmehealth.com>
Date: Tue, 11 May 2027 09:03:10 -0700
Subject: Re: Draft: Eval trajectory + MAP sketch — initial share

Thanks Hannah — appreciate the fast turnaround and the doc. A few quick clarifying Qs from our side: 

1) Stakeholder coverage: Can you add a proposed clinical ops contact? Tom (cc'd) will be our product lead, but we need clinical signoff from someone on the trials team.
2) Data residency: We need to confirm VPC-only traffic and the option for on-prem key management (HSM). Can you flag where in the MAP we surface that?
3) Performance targets: 150ms for 512 tokens looks good, but our baseline datasets will likely have many 800–1000 token requests. Can you add a perf slice for 1k tokens?

Workshop: May 18 works for us (afternoon PST). Please include suggested agenda + pre-reads. Also, is there a light-weight acceptance checklist you can hand off to legal to speed procurement?

I'll review the starter doc and leave comments.

— Jenna
Director, Innovation Programs | Acme Health
jenna@acmehealth.com

---
From: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
To: Hannah Schmitt <hannah_schmitt@redwood.com>, Jonas Weber <jonas_weber@redwood.com>
Date: Wed, 12 May 2027 11:45:30 -0700
Subject: Re: Draft: Eval trajectory + MAP sketch — internal prep notes

Hannah / Jonas —

I looked through Jenna's notes. Quick internal notes and suggested edits before we push the doc to Acme: 

- Add a clinical ops owner: Mina Haddad suggested (cc'ed on this thread) — she'll be our internal point for mapping clinical approvals and can join the workshop.
- Data residency: add a Network/VPC checkbox and an item under Week 5 for KMS/HSM options. I'll attach a concise procurement checklist (acceptance-checklist.xlsx) that legal can use as a starting point.
- Perf targets: propose we add a second perf row: 95th-percentile <= 300ms for 1k-token runs (best-effort; highlight that desktop profiling is required).
- Risk table: include a fallback model variant for the first 2 weeks in case we hit TPU/GPU capacity constraints (helps with SLA expectations).

I'll assemble the 'legal-friendly' acceptance checklist and the stakeholder RACI as standalone attachments and drop back into the doc before Hannah replies to Jenna.

Marissa Cole
Senior Solutions Engineer | Redwood Inference
marissa_cole@redwood.com

Attachments: acceptance-checklist.xlsx

From: Hannah Schmitt <hannah_schmitt@redwood.com>
To: Jenna Porter <jenna@acmehealth.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>, Jonas Weber <jonas_weber@redwood.com>, Mina Haddad <mina_haddad@redwood.com>
Date: Thu, 13 May 2027 08:20:44 -0700
Subject: Re: Draft: Eval trajectory + MAP sketch — initial share

Jenna —

Perfect — thanks for the callouts. I made the following updates and pushed them to the MAP starter doc (linked below):
- Added Mina as clinical ops owner and a suggested review cadence for clinical stakeholders
- Inserted a Network & KMS/HSM section under Week 5 for procurement owners to review
- Added a second perf slice (1k tokens) with the proposed 95th-percentile <= 300ms target and a profiling checklist
- Included a fallback-model row in the risk table for capacity-driven degradation

Documents: 
- MAP (editable): https://docs.google.com/document/d/1aBcD_example_map_link
- RACI + acceptance checklist (attached in this thread)

Proposed workshop agenda (90 mins):
1) 10m Introductions & success criteria alignment (all)
2) 25m Network & security constraints (Redwood infra + Acme infra)
3) 25m Sample integration & perf baseline design (SEs + Eng)
4) 20m Acceptance gates & procurement timeline (Legal/Procurement + CS)
5) 10m Action items & owners (close out)

Suggested times: Tuesday May 18 at 13:00 PST (90m) — if that works, I'll send the calendar invite and include pre-reads (MAP + acceptance checklist). Also linking our HubSpot record: https://hubspot.com/contacts/HS-48291 and the DocuSign envelope we'll use for a term sheet when ready: https://app.redwood.com/docusign/Envelope12345

If that time is good, Tom or Jenna — please confirm and I'll lock the slot.

Thanks, all.

— Hannah
Enterprise AE | Redwood Inference
